title.note: Game title kept byte-identical (glossary: keep); Slovenian players see and search the English Roblox title.

hud.cast.note: 2sg imperative of vreči (throw the line in); 4/8.

hud.reel.note: Perfective imperative of naviti (wind the line onto the reel), the angler's verb; not imperfective 'Navijaj', which also reads as 'cheer'. Same root as the pass Samonavijanje. 5/8. 'Potegni' (pull) is clearer to non-anglers but cannot share a root with the Auto Reel pass name.

hud.bait_left.note: Label form so 0, 1, 2, 3 and 5+ all read right (1 vaba, 2 vabi, 3 vabe, 5 vab). 6/10.

catch.success.note: Guide pattern '{rarity} ljubljenček izvaljen: {pet}!' with ulov (catch, m.) as head noun: avoids gendered 'Ujel si' / 'Ujela si' and keeps {fish} in the nominative after the colon, so the fish's gender never matters. Every rarity.* key must be masculine nominative (Redki, Legendarni, Mitski) to agree with ulov. 'Mitski ulov: Svetleča jegulja!' is 30 chars.

catch.escaped.note: Generic riba (fish) as context allows; the past participle agrees with riba (f.), not the player. Space before the ellipsis per the guide.

catch.new_record.note: Code issue for the developer: {weight} arrives as '12.4'; Slovenian writes the decimal comma '12,4' and uses the period as the group separator, so format the number per locale.

fish.golden_carp.note: Definite 'zlati' as a fixed species name; krap is the Slovenian carp (not 'zlata ribica', which is goldfish).

fish.lantern_eel.note: 'Glowing eel', keeping the glowing-lantern idea: an adjective from svetilka/laterna is unnatural, and 'Lampijonska jegulja' (paper lantern) is 19 > 18. 'Svetleča' matches the guide's 'svetleči krog'. 'Jegulja svetilka' (16) would keep 'lantern' literally if the owner wants it. 16/18.

rarity.mythic.note: Masculine definite tier label, standard Slovenian 'mitski' (mitska bitja); agrees with 'ulov' in catch.success like Legendarni and Redki. Ranks above Legendarni by the same game convention as English. 6/10.

shop.rods.note: Fishing rods (ribiška palica); 'Ribiške palice' is 14 > 10, and in a fishing shop tab 'Palice' reads only as rods.

shop.equip.note: 'Use' as the button, paired with the state label 'V uporabi'; avoids calque 'Opremi', which takes the player, not the rod, as object. 7/10.

shop.equipped.note: 'In use': a state that needs no gender agreement with palica, as the context allows. 9/11.

shop.free.note: 'Brezplačno' is 10 > 8; 'zastonj' is standard Slovenian (no charge) and friendly for a kids' shop. 7/8.

pass.auto_reel.note: 'Self-reeling', built like samopostrežba and samonavijalna ura; same root as hud.reel 'Navij'. 'Samodejno navijanje' is 19 > 14. 13/14. Creator Hub pass name should match.

pass.lucky_bait.text: Vaba sreče podvoji možnost, da ujameš redko ribo!
pass.lucky_bait.note: Pass name follows the guide's 'Napoj sreče' (Lucky Potion) pattern from the glossary words vaba and sreča. Possessive 'your' dropped; present 'ujameš' is gender-free. 'redko' shares the Redki stem.

sell.done.note: Label form for both numbers: 'Prodal si 12 rib za 340 kovancev' would be gendered and break for 1-4 (1 riba, 2 ribi, 3 ribe; 1 kovanec, 2 kovanca, 3 kovanci). The '+' carries the source's 'for {coins} coins' (coins earned). 27/40, 32 with the samples.

sell.prompt.note: Guide pattern 'Pritisni E, da odpreš'. 21/21, no margin; 'Prodaj s tipko E' (16) if it clips. E kept (glossary).

ascend.button.note: Mechanic name as a noun, like the guide's 'Prerod' button; 'rise', as in a rise in rank. Avoids religious 'Vnebohod' and the climbing imperative 'Povzpni se', though 'vzpon' can also mean a mountain ascent. 'Napredovanje' is 12 > 10. 5/10.

ascend.confirm.text: Vzpon zdaj? Začneš znova, redke ribe pa odslej ujameš za {bonus} % pogosteje.
ascend.confirm.note: Built like the guide's 'Prerod zdaj? Izgubiš kovance, dobiš pa ...'. Present tense avoids gendered 'boš ujel'; 'odslej' (from now on) carries the English future and the permanent bonus. 'za 25 % pogosteje' is the Slovenian way to say 'by 25% more often'. No-break space before % (CLDR); use a plain space if the font lacks U+00A0.

weather.storm.text: Prihaja nevihta! Redke ribe zdaj prijemajo.
weather.storm.note: 'prijemati' is the angler's verb for fish taking the bait (prijem = a bite), so it cannot be read as biting people; 'zdaj' renders the English progressive. 43/60.

quest.catch_n.note: Count after a colon because 'Ujemi {n} rib' breaks for 1-4 (1 ribo, 2 ribi, 3 ribe, 5 rib). Moonlit Bay as 'Mesečinski zaliv', named like real bays (Piranski zaliv), here in the locative. If in-world signs show the English name, they will not match (glossary: developer chose translate). 33/40.

friends.boost.note: Statement, not an order. Keeps '+'; no-break space before % (CLDR); use a plain space if the font lacks U+00A0. 'ribolov' is standard Slovenian (SSKJ).

trade.sent.note: Head noun igralcu takes the dative so {player} is never declined, and 'ponujena' agrees with menjava, not the sender; generic masculine 'igralcu' is the guide's pattern. 'Prošnja za menjavo poslana igralcu' is 35 > 33, and the colon form '... poslana: {player}' could read as if {player} sent it. 25/33.

trade.accept.note: Present 'se strinja' (agrees to) avoids gendered 'je sprejel' / 'je sprejela'; possessive 'your' dropped per the guide. Alternative 'Menjava sprejeta: {player}' (19). 21/33.

codes.redeemed.note: Guide's 'unovči kodo' for redeem; possessive 'your' dropped. 32/45.

afk.kicked.text: Predolgo te ni bilo, zato se je ribolov ustavil.
afk.kicked.note: Every 2sg past form (bil si nedejaven/nedejavna, nisi naredil/naredila) is gendered, so this uses impersonal 'te ni bilo' ('you were away'); 'se je ustavil' agrees with ribolov. Plainer alternative: 'Zaradi predolgega mirovanja se je ribolov ustavil.' No mention of removal from the server, as the source has none.

event.ends.note: Guide's 'Konec dogodka čez {time}' is 20 > 14, and the banner above names the event. 10/14. {time} like '2d 4h' reads fine in Slovenian (d, h); if minutes are ever shown, ask the developer for 'min', since 'm' is the metre.

daily.streak.text: {day}. dan zapored! Vrni se jutri po še več nagrad.
daily.streak.note: Ordinal '{day}. dan zapored' (day N in a row) is correct for every value, including 1, and carries the streak without a cryptic 'Niz'. 'for more' rendered as 'more rewards'. 46/62.

tip.night.text: Namig: nekatere ribe prijemajo samo ponoči.
tip.night.note: 'Namig:' is the usual Slovenian tip label; same angling verb 'prijemati' as weather.storm. 43/60.

group.join.text: Pridruži se naši skupini in dobi 50 brezplačnih vab!
group.join.note: Guide's 'Pridruži se naši skupini' (the studio's own group). 50 is fixed, so genitive plural 'vab' is always right. Contains č and ž: needs a font that has them (not Fredoka One). 52/60.

leaderboard.biggest.note: 'Heaviest catch', since the board ranks by weight; 'Največji ulov' (13) is equally natural if the owner prefers. 13/18.
